meta.title: MVC-100352-Check heating modes during runtime while streaming OP active
meta.description: Heating modes while the overheat protection is active and the camera streams, the heating has to stay off even when it is switched on manually
meta.author: Ehu Li

result.description: Preconditions
SW config 10C1 (rcam_2): service port 30501, SD 239.120.1.1:30490, 8 ROIs, Tauto 15.0/20.0 degC, Tprotection 45.0/40.0 degC
Production data Volvo_Standard_1Gbit_SN00012803.py: MAC 98:d3:d2:00:32:03, serial 00012803, hwVer 01H-

Open point 1: the serializer block is read as Q9.7. Shared_Functions_Library 4.13 converts it with T_Ser = T_EST_OUT / 2 - 273 instead, which gives 3631 degC for the block 0x1E80 measured at 50 degC ambient. All conversions are logged, the scale needs a confirmation from MEKRA.

Open point 2: Q9.7 is the scale that fits the measurements. The die settles 10.9 K above 50 degC and 12.0 K above 20 degC ambient, a self-heating that repeats over both setpoints, while Q8.8 would put the die 20 to 27 K below its own ambient.
Open point 3: subscribe payload 0xC000003 has seven digits, used is 0xC0000003.
Open point 4: Request ID 0x0000000F on the unsubscribe only, used is 0x12345678.
Open point 5: the steps wait a fixed hour per chamber setpoint, here the temperature criteria decide.
Open point 6: the second criterion needs Timager > Tauto_off (20.0 degC) at a chamber setpoint of 20.0 degC. That leaves no margin and only works through the self-heating of the imager.
Open point 7: 'check RTP stream' does not say how. The test listens on the port the parameter set defines and treats one received packet within 2.0 s as an active stream.
